verses.text: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD’s name! Praise him, you servants of the LORD,
you who stand in the LORD’s house, in the courtyards of our God’s house.
Praise the LORD because he’s good. Sing praises to his name because it’s a joy to do it.
The LORD chose Jacob for himself, Israel as his own special possession.
I know the LORD is great. Our Lord is above all gods.
Whatever the LORD wanted to do, he did, in heaven, on earth, in the seas, and in all the depths.
He raises clouds from the ends of the earth. He makes lightning flash with the rain. He brings wind out of his storehouses.
He struck down Egypt’s firstborn, both people and animals.
Egypt, he sent signs and wonders right into the middle of you, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
He struck many nations and killed powerful kings:
Sihon, king of the Amorites, Og, king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan.
He gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to Israel, his people.
LORD, your name lasts forever. Your fame goes on through every generation.
The LORD will judge his people and show compassion to his servants.
The nations’ idols are silver and gold, made by human hands.
They’ve got mouths but can’t speak. They’ve got eyes but can’t see.
They’ve got ears but can’t hear. There isn’t even a breath in their mouths.
The people who make them will end up like them, and so will everybody who trusts them.
Family of Israel, praise the LORD! Family of Aaron, praise the LORD!
Family of Levi, praise the LORD! Everyone who fears the LORD, praise the LORD!
Bless the LORD from Zion, the one who lives in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
